falsification_criterion: The 'per-system published Ea' / 'chemistry-specific per-system Ea' framing used by R-C02 and its full lineage (original KPI, potlife-q10-heuristic-ablation-v1, potlife-lofo-family-safe-v1, potlife-lovo-source-safe-v1, potlife-lofso-combined-safe-v1) is falsified if, for the 12-system locked fixture, EITHER (a) any activation_energy_source is a family/class-level approximate citation (contains an explicit '~' tolerance marker and/or a class-level qualifier word: 'family', 'type', 'framework') rather than a system-specific exact citation, OR (b) any system's activation_energy_source and pot_life_source are drawn from two independently authored documents (cross-source pairing) rather than one document reporting both quantities for the same physical formulation.

target_claim_text.dof_accounting: For every system s, the leg-L correction factor is computed from the OTHER 11 systems only (leave-one-system-out); system s's own datum never informs its own correction. No temperature-domain extrapolation of a per-system curve (avoids the T0-identifiability failure mode that refuted VFT in potlife-arrhenius-curvature-mechanism-v1).
target_claim_text.form: corrected_pred(s, L) = arrhenius_pred(s, L) * exp(mean_{i != s}[ln(observed_i,L / arrhenius_pred_i,L)])
target_claim_text.name: LOSO cross-system multiplicative bias correction on incumbent per-system published-Ea Arrhenius
target_claim_text.physical_basis: Corrects the already-established, direction-consistent (12/12 systems, both warm legs) convexity of ln(pot life) vs 1/T reported in potlife-arrhenius-curvature-mechanism-v1, using an empirical population-level calibration factor rather than a per-system parametric curvature law.

verdict_meaning: REFUTED: the 'per-system published Ea' framing carried by every receipt in the R-C02 lineage mischaracterizes the fixture. Of 12 systems, 8 (66.7%) cite a family/class-level literature-average Ea rather than a system-specific value, and 12/12 (100.0%) pair that Ea citation with a pot-life measurement drawn from an entirely different, independently authored document (a named vendor TDS) for a commercial product distinct from whatever specimen the Ea study measured. This does not dispute the MAPE arithmetic in R-C02/LOFO/LOVO/LOFSO (those numbers are recomputed correctly from the fixture as written); it disputes the physical-admissibility framing that the model is built on genuinely per-system published activation energies.
